text: 中国央行：7月末，本外币存款余额354.49万亿元，同比增长8.1%。月末人民币存款余额346.47万亿元，同比增长8.1%。 前七个月人民币存款增加17.79万亿元。其中，住户存款增加6.95万亿元，非金融企业存款增加1.57万亿元，财政性存款增加1.95万亿元，非银行业金融机构存款增加5.76万亿元。 7月末，外币存款余额1.18万亿美元，同比增长17.9%。前七个月外币存款增加1212亿美元。
text_en: PBOC: At the end of July, deposits in local and foreign currencies totaled 354.49 trillion yuan, up 8.1% year on year. RMB deposits at the end of the month stood at 346.47 trillion yuan, up 8.1% year on year. RMB deposits increased by 17.79 trillion yuan in the first seven months. Among them, household deposits increased by 6.95 trillion yuan, non-financial corporate deposits increased by 1.57 trillion yuan, fiscal deposits increased by 1.95 trillion yuan, and deposits of non-banking financial institutions increased by 5.76 trillion yuan. At the end of July, foreign currency deposits stood at $1.18 trillion, up 17.9% year on year. In the first seven months, foreign currency deposits increased by $121.2 billion.
